summary: fix(settings): rename Pair2 cancelled heading Fluent ids
description:
## Because

- The parent commit respelled the two Pair2 cancellation headings to "Cancelled" but kept the old Fluent ids.
- A maintainer asked for the opposite, so this round renames the ids.
- The FxA l10n convention gives a string a new id when its English value changes. Translators then see new work instead of a stale translation.

## This pull request

- Renames `pair2-authority-timeout-and-cancel-canceled-heading` to `pair2-authority-timeout-and-cancel-cancelled-heading`.
- Renames `pair2-supplicant-timeout-and-cancel-canceled-heading` to `pair2-supplicant-timeout-and-cancel-cancelled-heading`.
- Updates `headingFtlId` in the two sibling `index.tsx` files.
- Leaves the two `-canceled-description` ids alone, because their English values did not change.

## Issue that this pull request solves

Closes: https://mozilla-hub.atlassian.net/browse/FXA-14503
